lakecave2_troll_10.m: You! You have no business here! Get out of my cave!
r: Of course, sorry, please excuse the disturbance.
May I ask a question before I leave?

lakecave2_troll_12.m: That was already a question! Hahaha! You are lucky that I am in good mood - and not hungry at the moment.

r: I am looking for my brother Andor. Have you seen him?
I am looking for some flowers called damerilias.
Someone lost a key here. Once I have found the key, you can have your wet, dark hole to yourself again.

lakecave2_troll_20.m: No. If your brother looks like you then I have never seen him, and if I had then I would have eaten him! Now go!

lakecave2_troll_30.m:
Everyone is after my damerilias! For what? Such ugly, stinking things!
No, I won't give you a single one. And you really should leave now, before I get hungry!
r: What do you need damerilias for, if you don't like them?

lakecave2_troll_32.m: The damerilias attract food for me; tasty, delicate, little people. Catching them is kind of a sport for me. It makes eating more fun.

lakecave2_troll_34.m: But talking about food with a troll is not the smartest idea...

lakecave2_troll_40.m: What do you know about the key? I keep the key safe. Are you associated with that thief who comes once a year and steals my damerilias?
r: Do you mean Noraed? He is dead.

lakecave2_troll_50.m: Dead? No - what a pity! I am really sorry. What a loss.

lakecave2_troll_52.m: I was so looking forward to eating him.
r: I would like to take some damerilias for his grave.

lakecave2_troll_60.m: Forget it. Especially because you know those people who built that terrible statue near the entrance.
r: What is terrible about that statue?

lakecave2_troll_62.m: It is a bane for all trolls. We avoid going past, or even near, her.

lakecave2_troll_64.m: I might let you go if you remove that ghastly statue. Maybe I'll even give you two of those ugly plants for that. Agreed?
r: No. That statue is a blessing for the people here. Even if I could, I would not tear it down.

lakecave2_troll_70.m: You lie. You think I am just a stupid troll.

lakecave2_troll_90.m: Outrageous! I will put you in my pantry now.

secret_garden.10:
Caeda in Remgard told me I can find fresh damerilias in her family's glade, but the key was taken by monsters.
If I can find the key in the cave north of Remgard, I can access that glade, but I have to return the key to Caeda.
secret_garden.20: Finding the key was not worth the trouble. The wilted damerilias Caeda gave me will be just fine.
secret_garden.30: I killed some monsters and found the key to the glade.
secret_garden.40: I returned the key right away to Caeda.
secret_garden.45: I kept the key for a while, but finally returned it to Caeda.
secret_garden.50: Caeda asked for my help to clear out the monsters in the caves so that she can go back there and attend to the flowers.
secret_garden.55: Many monsters are dead now. The rest will no longer dare to approach the statue.
secret_garden.60: I told Caeda, so that she can attend to the glade.

roots_love.10: Aryfora, a woman grieving in Stoutford's graveyard asked me to bring her some damerilias from Remgard for the grave of Noraed, her husband.
roots_love.20: Noraed's sister, Caeda, gave me some damerilias. I should bring them back to Stoutford.
roots_love.30: I have brought the damerilias back to Aryfora. She thanked me with a potion she made.
roots_love.40: I told her the flowers were from Noraed's sister, Caeda.
roots_love.45: I told her I found the flowers around Remgard, in the wild.
